gap.en: There remains a significant gap in our understanding of early neural development.
gap.zh: 我们对早期神经发育的理解仍存在显著空白。

gap.en: The pay gap between senior and junior staff widened considerably last year.
gap.zh: 去年高级员工与初级员工之间的薪酬差距明显扩大。

gap.en: This review identifies a gap in the literature regarding adolescent sleep patterns.
gap.zh: 这篇综述指出了现有文献在青少年睡眠模式方面的研究空白。

gradient.en: The gradient of the hill becomes much steeper beyond the second ridge.
gradient.zh: 越过第二道山脊后，山坡的坡度变得陡峭得多。

gradient.en: Researchers measured the concentration gradient across the river estuary over time.
gradient.zh: 研究人员沿河口测量了浓度梯度随时间的变化。

gradient.en: A sharp gradient in temperature can cause thermal stress for coral reefs.
gradient.zh: 水温梯度过大会对珊瑚礁造成热应激。

heterogeneity.en: Substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects was observed across the twelve participating clinics.
heterogeneity.zh: 在 12 家参与诊所之间观察到了治疗效果的显著异质性。

heterogeneity.en: The index was designed to capture heterogeneity within the population rather than averages.
heterogeneity.zh: 该指标旨在捕捉总体内部的不均一性，而非平均水平。

heterogeneity.en: Inter-rater heterogeneity reduced the overall reliability of the qualitative coding.
heterogeneity.zh: 评分者之间的差异降低了定性编码的整体信度。

incidence.en: The incidence of the disease has declined sharply since vaccination programs began.
incidence.zh: 自疫苗接种项目启动以来，该病的发生率大幅下降。

incidence.en: These estimates of incidence rely on hospital records collected over fifteen years.
incidence.zh: 这些发生率估算依赖于 15 年间收集的医院记录。

incidence.en: Higher incidence of respiratory infection was reported among older residents.
incidence.zh: 老年居民中呼吸道感染的发生率更高。

inference.en: The inference from experimental data to real-world outcomes requires careful reasoning.
inference.zh: 从实验数据推断现实结果需要谨慎的推理。

inference.en: Bayesian inference allows researchers to update beliefs as new data arrive.
inference.zh: 贝叶斯推断使研究者能够随新数据的到来更新信念。

inference.en: Any inference drawn from a single small sample should be treated cautiously.
inference.zh: 任何基于单个小样本得出的推论都应谨慎对待。

intervention.en: A targeted intervention reduced hospital readmissions among patients with chronic conditions.
intervention.zh: 一项有针对性的干预措施减少了慢性病患者的再次住院率。

intervention.en: The policy intervention was piloted in three districts before national rollout.
intervention.zh: 该政策干预在三个地区先行试点，然后才在全国推行。

intervention.en: Early intervention in the classroom improved long-term literacy outcomes considerably.
intervention.zh: 课堂上的早期干预显著改善了长期的读写能力结果。

justification.en: The authors provide a clear justification for choosing this particular dataset.
justification.zh: 作者为选择这一特定数据集给出了清晰的理由。

justification.en: No compelling justification was offered for excluding participants from the analysis.
justification.zh: 对于将参与者排除在分析之外，并未给出令人信服的理由。

justification.en: The ethical committee demanded further justification of the proposed procedure.
justification.zh: 伦理委员会要求对所提议的程序作出进一步的理由说明。

limitation.en: A major limitation of the study is its relatively small sample size.
limitation.zh: 该研究的一个主要局限在于样本量相对较小。

limitation.en: The authors acknowledge several limitations concerning measurement and geographic representativeness.
limitation.zh: 作者承认了测量和地理代表性方面的若干局限。

limitation.en: This limitation restricts the conclusions that can reasonably be drawn.
limitation.zh: 这一局限限制了可以合理得出的结论。

literature.en: The literature on climate adaptation has grown rapidly over the past decade.
literature.zh: 关于气候适应的文献在过去 10 年中迅速增长。

literature.en: A comprehensive review of the literature reveals considerable disagreement among scholars.
literature.zh: 对文献的综合评述显示学者之间存在相当大的分歧。

literature.en: Students must engage with the primary literature before writing their essays.
literature.zh: 学生在撰写论文之前必须研读原始文献。

margin.en: The margin of error in the estimate is roughly three percentage points.
margin.zh: 该估计值的误差范围约为三个百分点。

margin.en: Profit margin improved significantly after the company restructured its supply chain.
margin.zh: 公司重组供应链后，利润率显著提高。

margin.en: There is very little margin for delay in this tight schedule.
margin.zh: 在这份紧凑的日程安排中，几乎没有延误的余地。

narrative.en: The author constructs a compelling narrative around a single family's experience.
narrative.zh: 作者围绕一个家庭的经历构建了引人入胜的叙事。

narrative.en: Quantitative data alone cannot capture the narrative behind these statistics.
narrative.zh: 仅凭定量数据无法呈现这些统计数据背后的叙事。

narrative.en: The final chapter shifts the narrative focus to rural communities.
narrative.zh: 最后一章将叙事的焦点转向农村社区。

outlier.en: We removed each outlier only after confirming the measurement error.
outlier.zh: 只有在确认测量误差后，我们才剔除每一个离群值。

outlier.en: This extreme outlier skewed the mean and distorted the trend line.
outlier.zh: 这个极端离群值使均值发生偏移并扭曲了趋势线。

outlier.en: A formal outlier analysis revealed three observations that required further investigation.
outlier.zh: 离群值分析揭示出三个需要进一步调查的观测值。

oversight.en: Regulatory oversight of the laboratory ensured compliance with safety standards.
oversight.zh: 对该实验室的监管确保了安全标准的遵守。

oversight.en: The error resulted from a simple lack of oversight during the night shift.
oversight.zh: 这一错误源于夜班期间缺乏监督。

oversight.en: Recent oversight reforms have strengthened accountability across the public sector.
oversight.zh: 近期的监管改革加强了公共部门的问责。

phenomenon.en: This linguistic phenomenon occurs in every major language studied so far.
phenomenon.zh: 这一语言现象出现在迄今为止研究过的所有主要语言中。

phenomenon.en: The emergence of new trade routes was a gradual phenomenon spanning centuries.
phenomenon.zh: 新贸易路线的出现是一个延续数百年的渐进现象。

phenomenon.en: Scientists still debate whether the observed phenomenon reflects a genuine effect.
phenomenon.zh: 科学家仍在争论所观察到的现象是否反映了真实效应。

prevalence.en: The prevalence of diabetes has increased steadily over the past decade.
prevalence.zh: 过去 10 年中糖尿病的患病率持续上升。

prevalence.en: Estimates of prevalence were derived from a nationally representative survey.
prevalence.zh: 患病率估计值来自一项具有全国代表性的调查。

prevalence.en: High prevalence of the condition makes early screening clinically valuable.
prevalence.zh: 该疾病的高患病率使早期筛查具有临床价值。

proportion.en: A large proportion of respondents reported working more than fifty hours weekly.
proportion.zh: 很大一部分受访者报告每周工作 50 小时以上。

proportion.en: The proportion of women in senior positions rose to thirty percent.
proportion.zh: 担任高级职务的女性比例上升到了 30%。

proportion.en: Only a small proportion of the total sample received the intervention.
proportion.zh: 总样本中只有一小部分接受了干预。

proxy.en: Income is often used as a proxy for household consumption in developing regions.
proxy.zh: 在发展中地区，收入常被用作家庭消费的代理指标。

proxy.en: Tree rings serve as a useful proxy for historical rainfall over centuries.
proxy.zh: 年轮可作为数百年来历史降雨情况的有用替代指标。

proxy.en: Researchers warned that the proxy variable may introduce serious measurement error.
proxy.zh: 研究人员警告说，该替代变量可能引入严重的测量误差。

regression.en: Multiple regression analysis revealed that income explained most of the variation.
regression.zh: 多元回归分析显示，收入解释了大部分变异。

regression.en: The new model showed no regression in accuracy over the past year.
regression.zh: 新模型在过去一年中精度没有出现倒退。

regression.en: Further regression testing confirmed that the software upgrade fixed the original bug.
regression.zh: 进一步的回归测试确认软件升级修复了原有的缺陷。

reliability.en: Inter-rater reliability exceeded eighty percent across both coders in this study.
reliability.zh: 在本研究中，两位编码者的评分者间信度超过 80%。

reliability.en: The reliability of the instrument improves substantially after extensive pilot testing.
reliability.zh: 经过大量预试后，该工具的可靠性显著提高。

reliability.en: Reviewers questioned the reliability of self-reported data collected by email.
reliability.zh: 审稿人质疑了通过电子邮件收集的自报数据的可靠性。

reproducibility.en: The reproducibility of published findings is a cornerstone of good scientific practice.
reproducibility.zh: 已发表结果的可复现性是良好科学实践的基石。

reproducibility.en: The journal now requires full reproducibility of computational analyses where possible.
reproducibility.zh: 该期刊现要求在可能的情况下实现计算分析完全可复现。

reproducibility.en: Improving reproducibility reduces duplicated effort across research laboratories worldwide.
reproducibility.zh: 提高可复现性可以减少全球各研究实验室的重复劳动。

retrospective.en: This retrospective analysis examined records collected between 1998 and 2012.
retrospective.zh: 这项回顾性分析考察了 1998 年至 2012 年间收集的记录。

retrospective.en: A retrospective review of the data revealed a previously unnoticed seasonal pattern.
retrospective.zh: 对数据的回顾发现了一个此前未被注意到的季节性模式。

retrospective.en: The team adopted a retrospective design because no baseline data existed.
retrospective.zh: 由于不存在基线数据，团队采用了回顾性设计。

sample.en: The convenience sample was drawn from students at a single university.
sample.zh: 便利样本取自一所大学的学生。

sample.en: Each soil sample was analyzed in triplicate by the laboratory.
sample.zh: 实验室对每个土壤样品进行了三次平行分析。

sample.en: The sample size was determined through a formal power calculation.
sample.zh: 样本量通过正式的效能计算确定。

saturation.en: Data collection continued until saturation was reached in the interview transcripts.
saturation.zh: 数据收集持续进行，直到访谈转录文本达到饱和。

saturation.en: Market saturation in developed economies has slowed revenue growth considerably.
saturation.zh: 发达经济体的市场饱和已明显减缓了收入增长。

saturation.en: Oxygen saturation remained stable throughout the entire experimental procedure.
saturation.zh: 在整个实验过程中血氧饱和度保持稳定。

sensitivity.en: The instrument demonstrated good sensitivity for detecting early signs of disease.
sensitivity.zh: 该工具在检测疾病早期迹象方面表现出良好的灵敏度。

sensitivity.en: A sensitivity analysis showed that the results were robust to alternative assumptions.
sensitivity.zh: 敏感性分析表明，结果对替代假设而言是稳健的。

sensitivity.en: Researchers reported high sensitivity but only moderate specificity in the test.
sensitivity.zh: 研究人员报告该检测的敏感性很高，但特异性仅为中等。

specificity.en: The high specificity of the test means few false positives occur.
specificity.zh: 该检测的高特异性意味着假阳性很少出现。

specificity.en: A specificity analysis confirmed that the marker distinguishes closely related cell types.
specificity.zh: 特异性分析证实该标记物能够区分密切相关的细胞类型。

specificity.en: Critics questioned the specificity of these findings across different populations.
specificity.zh: 批评者质疑这些发现在不同人群中是否具有特异性。

spectrum.en: Electromagnetic radiation covers a wide spectrum of wavelengths beyond visible light.
spectrum.zh: 电磁辐射涵盖可见光以外宽广的波长谱。

spectrum.en: The findings represent one end of the spectrum of possible interpretations.
spectrum.zh: 这些发现代表了由各种可能解释构成的连续体中的一端。

spectrum.en: Researchers analyzed the whole spectrum of responses from the participants.
spectrum.zh: 研究人员分析了参与者的全部反应类型。

statistic.en: This statistic summarizes the central tendency of the observed measurements.
statistic.zh: 该统计量概括了观测测量值的集中趋势。

statistic.en: The reported statistic was calculated from only a handful of observations.
statistic.zh: 所报告的统计量仅根据少数几个观测值计算得出。

statistic.en: Before quoting a statistic, always report the sample size and units.
statistic.zh: 引用统计量之前，总要报告样本量和计量单位。

tension.en: There is growing tension between economic growth and environmental protection.
tension.zh: 经济增长与环境保护之间的紧张关系日益加剧。

tension.en: The negotiations were marked by considerable tension between the two delegations.
tension.zh: 谈判中两个代表团之间存在相当大的紧张关系。

tension.en: The film explores the tension between tradition and modernity in rural communities.
tension.zh: 该影片探讨了农村社区中传统与现代之间的矛盾。

theorem.en: The proof of this theorem rests on a well-established lemma.
theorem.zh: 该定理的证明建立在一个公认引理的基础之上。

theorem.en: The theorem has been generalized in several subsequent papers.
theorem.zh: 该定理在随后的几篇论文中已被推广。

theorem.en: Applying the theorem to real data requires additional assumptions about error.
theorem.zh: 将该定理应用于真实数据需要关于误差的额外假设。

uncertainty.en: The model quantifies uncertainty through bootstrap confidence intervals around each estimate.
uncertainty.zh: 该模型通过每个估计值周围的自助法置信区间来量化不确定性。

uncertainty.en: Honest reporting of uncertainty strengthens the credibility of published research.
uncertainty.zh: 如实报告不确定性可以增强已发表研究的可信度。

uncertainty.en: Policy decisions must account for genuine uncertainty in the underlying evidence.
uncertainty.zh: 政策决策必须考虑底层证据中真实存在的不确定性。

verification.en: Independent verification of the results confirmed the original laboratory findings.
verification.zh: 对结果的独立验证证实了实验室最初的发现。

verification.en: The audit included verification of all reported financial figures.
verification.zh: 这次审计包括对所有已报告财务数据的核实。

verification.en: Document verification is required before any claim can be published.
verification.zh: 在任何主张发表之前都必须进行文件核查。

boundary.en: The boundary between private and public funding remains blurred in practice.
boundary.zh: 私人资助与公共资助之间的界限在实践中仍然模糊。

boundary.en: The study examines the boundary conditions under which the effect holds.
boundary.zh: 该研究考察了效应成立所需的边界条件。

boundary.en: Marking the boundary of the study area helped standardize field measurements.
boundary.zh: 标出研究区域的边界有助于统一野外测量标准。

baseline.en: All participants were assessed at baseline before receiving the treatment.
baseline.zh: 所有参与者在接受治疗前都接受了基线评估。

baseline.en: The baseline data allowed us to compare subsequent outcomes across the two groups.
baseline.zh: 基线数据使我们能够比较两组之后的结局。

baseline.en: The new method performs better than the baseline model on every dataset.
baseline.zh: 在每个数据集上，新方法都优于基线模型。

consistency.en: There is a marked consistency in the findings across three independent laboratories.
consistency.zh: 三个独立实验室的结果具有显著的一致性。

consistency.en: The internal consistency of the scale was assessed with an appropriate coefficient.
consistency.zh: 该量表的内部一致性以恰当的系数进行了评估。

consistency.en: Reviewers praised the consistency of the argument throughout the manuscript.
consistency.zh: 审稿人赞赏了全稿论证的一致性。

precision.en: The instrument achieves a precision of two decimal places.
precision.zh: 该仪器的精度达到小数点后两位。

precision.en: Greater measurement precision improved the accuracy of the estimated effect.
precision.zh: 更高的测量精确度提升了效应估计的准确性。

precision.en: In this context, precision is less important than validity.
precision.zh: 在这一情境下，精确性不如效度重要。

population.en: The study population included adults aged forty and above.
population.zh: 研究总体包括 40 岁及以上的成年人。

population.en: Higher population density influences the cost of delivering health services.
population.zh: 较高的人口密度会影响提供医疗服务的成本。

population.en: The population of the region has declined steadily over the past decade.
population.zh: 该地区的人口在过去 10 年中持续下降。

control.en: Every participant in the control group received the standard treatment.
control.zh: 对照组的每位参与者都接受了标准治疗。

control.en: Researchers controlled the temperature throughout the trial.
control.zh: 研究人员在整个试验期间控制着温度。

control.en: Randomly assigning participants to conditions controls for known confounders.
control.zh: 将参与者随机分配到各条件组可以控制已知的混杂因素。

coverage.en: Insurance coverage for mental health services remains limited in many countries.
coverage.zh: 在许多国家，心理健康服务的保险覆盖仍然有限。

coverage.en: Data coverage varied considerably across the participating regions.
coverage.zh: 各参与地区的数据覆盖范围差异相当大。

coverage.en: The review achieved full coverage of all published studies.
coverage.zh: 该综述实现了对所有已发表研究的完整覆盖。

replication.en: Direct replication of the study in a second laboratory confirmed the effect.
replication.zh: 在第二个实验室对该研究的直接复现证实了效应。

replication.en: A replication of the analysis confirmed that the estimates remained stable.
replication.zh: 对分析的复现证实了估计值保持稳定。

replication.en: The crisis exposed serious gaps in the replication of published results.
replication.zh: 这场危机暴露了已发表结果复现方面的严重缺陷。

retention.en: Employee retention improved markedly after the company introduced flexible working arrangements.
retention.zh: 公司引入弹性工作安排后，员工留存率明显提高。

retention.en: Water retention in sandy soils depends largely on organic matter content.
retention.zh: 沙质土壤的保水能力在很大程度上取决于有机质含量。

retention.en: The study examined retention rates across three successive cohorts of participants.
retention.zh: 该研究考察了连续三个参与者队列的留存率。
